It is very much a consultative environment rather than a role where you quietly wait for instructions - here you'll be bringing your own ideas, perspective and expertise to the team.

E-Commerce & Social Media Administrator
Are you organised, creative, customer-focused, and looking to build a career in digital business and marketing?
We are recruiting for an exciting newly created position within a growing and ambitious business. As our E-Commerce & Social Media Administrator, you will play a key role in supporting our online sales operation, managing customer interactions, and developing our digital presence.
This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys variety in their work and wants to take ownership of projects while contributing directly to the future growth of the business.
The Role
Reporting directly to the management team, you will oversee customer enquiries and online orders, ensuring a seamless customer experience from initial contact through to delivery.
You will also take responsibility for managing and developing our social media presence, creating engaging content, supporting marketing initiatives, and helping to strengthen our brand online.
In addition, you will provide general administrative support and assist customers both over the phone and in person when required.
Key Responsibilities
E-Commerce & Customer Management
- Manage and maintain customer records using the company CRM system.
- Process online orders and monitor customer journeys from enquiry through to delivery.
- Communicate with customers regarding orders, deliveries, and general enquiries.
- Ensure customer information and order details are accurate and up to date.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.

Digital Marketing & Social Media
- Manage and develop the company's social media channels.
- Create engaging content for platforms including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and others.
- Plan and deliver social media campaigns to increase brand awareness and generate enquiries.
- Monitor performance metrics and provide recommendations for improvement.
- Support the development of the company's wider digital marketing strategy.
- Assist with website updates, promotions, and online marketing activities.

Administration & Customer Support
- Provide general administrative support to the business.
- Answer telephone enquiries and respond to customer communications.
- Welcome and assist customers visiting the showroom.
- Support management with business development initiatives and special projects.

About You
We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, organised, and eager to learn. You will be comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and taking ownership of your responsibilities.
Essential Skills & Experience
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Confident using computers and learning new systems.
- Self-motivated with a proactive attitude.
- Strong written communication skills.
- Creative mindset with an interest in social media and marketing.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Experience managing social media accounts.
- Understanding of digital marketing principles.
- Experience using CRM or customer management software.
- Familiarity with e-commerce platforms.
- Qualification in marketing, business, digital media, or a related field.

What We Offer
- The opportunity to shape and develop a newly created role.
- Real ownership and responsibility from day one.
- Exposure to digital marketing, e-commerce, customer service, and business operations.
- A supportive working environment where your ideas are valued.
- Excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.
- The chance to play an important role in the continued growth and success of the business.

If you're looking for a varied and rewarding role where you can make a genuine impact, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Commercial Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing & Communications Manager

Overview

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing & Communications Manager to lead the development and delivery of impactful marketing, communications and media strategies. This is an exciting opportunity for a creative and influential professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about engaging audiences, building strong relationships and driving organisational growth.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver integrated marketing, communications and media strategies that enhance brand awareness and engagement.
- Create compelling content and campaigns across digital, social, print and traditional media channels.
- Manage public relations activity, media relations and external communications.
- Work closely with stakeholders across the organisation to identify opportunities and gather content for campaigns and communications.
- Lead and motivate colleagues and external partners to achieve shared objectives.
- Monitor, analyse and report on the effectiveness of marketing and communication activities, making recommendations for improvement.
- Ensure consistent messaging and brand standards across all communications.
- Manage multiple projects simultaneously, meeting deadlines and adapting to changing priorities.
- Support the promotion of organisational initiatives, services, events and fundraising activities where applicable.

About You

You will be:
- An experienced Marketing and Communications professional with a proven track record of developing and implementing successful communication and media strategies.
- A confident and engaging leader who can inspire and motivate others while building strong working relationships.
- Highly collaborative, with excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Creative, innovative and solutions-focused, with the ability to think strategically while delivering practical outcomes.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and responding quickly to changing circumstances.
- A strong project manager with excellent organisational and delegation skills.
- An effective communicator with outstanding written and verbal communication abilities.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Experience in marketing, communications, public relations or media management.
- Proven ability to develop and deliver strategic marketing and communications plans.
- Strong media relations and content creation experience.
- Excellent stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills.
- Experience managing multiple campaigns and projects simultaneously.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate campaign performance and drive continuous improvement.

Desirable Experience
- Experience working within the charity, not-for-profit or voluntary sector.
- Background in marketing, PR and communications within a purpose-led organisation.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join a growing and innovative business as a Digital Marketing Executive.

The role would suit someone who is commercially minded, highly organised and confident managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
- Based in Chessington
- No prior experience required
- £30,000 per annum + bonus
- Full-time
- On site gym

Key Responsibilities
- Plan, deliver and optimise digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
- Develop marketing strategies aligned with client and commercial objectives.
- Manage day-to-day client communication and build strong, professional stakeholder relationships.
- Take ownership of multiple accounts and projects, ensuring activity is delivered accurately and on schedule.
- Coordinate campaign requirements across internal teams to ensure effective execution.
- Monitor and analyse campaign performance, identifying opportunities to improve results.
- Produce clear performance reports and communicate outcomes and recommendations to relevant stakeholders.
- Use data and insights to inform future marketing activity and campaign decisions.
- Identify opportunities to improve account performance and support wider business growth.
- Maintain high standards of organisation, quality and accountability across all activity.
- Keep up to date with digital marketing developments, changing audience behaviours and emerging opportunities.
- Contribute ideas and recommendations to continually improve campaign performance and client experience.

About You
- Strong communication and relationship-management skills.
- Confident working directly with clients and internal stakeholders.
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- Commercially aware with a proactive and results-focused approach.
- Strong attention to detail
- Able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change.
- Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive
- Annual Salary: £35 K - £40 K DOE
- Location: Croydon
- Job Type: Full-time

We are seeking a proactive and creative Digital Marketing Executive to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about digital marketing and looking to make a significant impact in driving our brand's online presence. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing digital marketing strategies to enhance our online visibility, engage with our audience, and boost our marketing efforts.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns across various online platforms to increase brand awareness and generate leads.
- Manage the company's social media profiles and presence, including Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and additional channels that may be deemed relevant.
- Monitor and analyse the effectiveness of marketing content and campaigns, using tools like Google Analytics and other measurement tools to report on performance and make improvements.
- Collaborate with marketing, sales, and product development teams to create cohesive and effective strategies.
- Manage email and social media marketing campaigns, including content creation, segmentation, testing, sending, and reporting.
- Update the company website with fresh and engaging content aligned with SEO strategies to improve traffic and user engagement.
- Stay up-to-date with digital marketing trends and potential new channels and strategies to keep us ahead, including updates on digital marketing software and tools.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience as a Digital Marketing Executive or similar role.
- Excellent understanding of digital marketing concepts and best practices.
- Skills and experience in creative content writing.
- Analytical mindset and critical thinking.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong knowledge of web analytics tools like Google Analytics.
- Hands-on experience with SEO/SEM, Google AdWords, email campaigns, and social media marketing.
- Degree in Marketing, Digital technologies or relevant field is preferred.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary based on experience.
- Opportunities for professional development and training.
- Dynamic and creative work environment.
- Pension scheme and health benefits.

If you are interested in this role, please apply right away.
